z21_reproduction.description: Commutant of SU(3)_f acting irreducibly on C^3 (Schur's Lemma reproduction, cross-check of this solver against Z21's known result of exactly 1).

z44_su5AxSu5B_after_breaking_su5A.description: Commutant of the 12 SM generators (from broken SU(5)_A) acting as g(x)I_10 on the (5_A, 10bar_B) piece, family block dim 10, completely untouched.

z44_R1_correction.note: The ratio_z44_over_z21 (200.0) below compares an ungauged SU(5)_B (this file's original scope) against Z21's gauged SU(3)_f -- not a fair comparison.
z44_R1_correction.mathematical_reason: Schur's Lemma applied to both factors: SM (3+1 direct sum 1+2 on 5_A, two inequivalent irreps) x SU(5)_B irreducible on 10bar gives commutant Hom(V1,V1)+Hom(V2,V2)=1+1=2. The 200 figure arises because leaving SU(5)_B ungauged replaces Hom(W,W) with the full unconstrained End(C^10) (dim 100) instead of collapsing it to C via Schur.
